error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE:
"[GTPU] try to get a gtp-u not existing output"

Additional context:
- This error indicates an attempt to access a non-existent GTP-U tunnel output, which can disrupt user plane data forwarding.
- It occurs after the log entry "[GTPU] [90] UE ID 904: Delete all tunnels (1 tunnels)" and before "[RLC] Remove UE 904".
- Followed by "[NR_MAC] Unknown RNTI 0388 in PUCCH UCI" and "[HW] Lost socket", suggesting subsequent issues in MAC layer and hardware interface.

This error is the most critical as it reflects a failure in GTP-U tunnel management that could prevent proper data transmission and lead to connection loss.
